SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Factual Texts, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read at the right speed? 2. Why should we sign read at the right speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Factual Texts together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: interacting with technology as learners manipulate digital devices as they watch a signed video or a video with closed captions

related to the theme.

● Learning to learn: learner to develop the skill of independent learning as they use the dictionary and children’s encyclopaedia to obtain

information.

Values:
Unity: sharing as learner works together to retell, through signing, stories related to the theme.
